display_information.name: Ameen
display_information.description: The finance agent that remembers what was promised
display_information.long_description: Ameen lives in the channel where your team agrees things with vendors. When an invoice arrives weeks later, it already knows what was promised and cites the exact message. It matches invoices against purchase orders, vendor history and the conversation itself, chooses the approval level from what it finds, and removes the approval button entirely when a vendor's bank details change.
